description.en:
Sets the opacity of a named caption (created with one of the CMND_2DO_CREATE_*_TELOP functions).
Combined with CMND_2DO_STATE_DRAW_TELOP, this is how the scripts fade a caption in and out.

null if the engine is not ready, fewer than 2 arguments were given, or no caption has that name.
On success the native reports a result without pushing one, so Squirrel hands back the last argument (the alpha value).

examples.case: Making two captions visible but transparent, then fading them in (real usage, from ie4_soccer_sys.nut; caption names shortened from the script's Shift-JIS names)
